The auth.localhost route isn't reachable from the host via localhost:3000? The `auth.localhost:3000` resolves to 127.0.0.1 — but the traefik router routes based on Host header. Let me test with explicit Host header. Also curl to localhost:3000/realms/... returned the frontend HTML (vite), meaning traefik routed it to frontend as default. Let me test with Host header auth.localhost.

Actually `auth.localhost` - DNS resolves localhost to 127.0.0.1, so curl connects to 127.0.0.1:3000 with Host auth.localhost. But got HTTP 000 meaning connection failed? Maybe DNS resolution issue. Let me test the Host header approach.
